added.claim: The nested TestKit builds use the developer's real Gradle user home as the TestKit dir, so their results depend on that person's ~/.gradle/gradle.properties and init.d scripts. The lane recorded this as residual FND-101 and did not fix it. One concrete case: a global org.gradle.configuration-cache=true would break checkDependencyRules, which reads Project objects at execution time, so BuildChecksTest could fail on one machine and pass on another.
added.suggested_fix: Pass --no-configuration-cache, plus -I with an empty init script or explicit -D overrides, in runner(). Or use a dedicated TestKit dir seeded offline from the outer dependency cache.
